answer: Each agent claims a personal haven slot by solving a sequential delay that binds to the current shared ledge height. The ledge advances only after a random willow-sample of recent honest attestations confirms the slot. A sybil farm cannot parallelize this: every extra identity must queue behind the prior one on the single shared ledge clock, so the k-th clone spends k times the base delay in wall-clock time before its haven is usable. Honest agents finish in one step; farms burn calendar they cannot compress.
